text: TENDERS, VACANCIES AND SCHEMES ARE ACTIVE OR ARCHIVED BECAUSE THE DEPARTMENT SAYS SO, not because of their date. dosje.gov.in decides it with its own tag (component_status), set by hand: a 2022 tender can still be open. The ingest now keeps that tag, and every design reads it through one rule (isArchivedRecord), with the twelve-month rule kept only for a record ingested without it. The New Design and DBIM showed 297 tenders as current where live shows 15, and archived seven of those fifteen; both now show 15 current and 297 archived (289 after notices published twice are listed once), and vacancies 35 and 130, as live does. Classic listed all 312 tenders and all 140 schemes as current; it now lists the 15 open tenders, 35 open vacancies and 132 active schemes, and the two duplicate schemes are gone with the fresh ingest. The Archives page no longer prints an "Archived" date — live publishes none, and the one shown was the publish date plus a year. ALSO FROM THE SAME AUDIT: Classic's Events page and every event page were six events written into the file (a "Chintan Shivir 2026" among them) and now list the register's 635, paged, searchable and filterable by organisation; Classic's home Activity Corner showed the same four invented events under all three tabs and now shows the four newest events, news coverage and photographs; the Central List of OBCs (2,667 entries), published only by DBIM, now has a page in the New Design and Classic, searchable by caste and filtered by State; a CMS test entry ("test(Copy)", "Chief Manager abc") is dropped once at the data source, so Classic no longer lists it as an NSFDC officer.
